newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Simsmetal shares dip as profits slide.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Simsmetal shares dip as profits slide.

text.p: Shares in metal recycler Simsmetal Ltd dipped sharply on Tuesday after the company announced a 43 percent fall in half year net profit to A$14.07 million.
In a weak market, Simsmetal shares were trading two cents lower at A$7.26 prior to the announcement but by mid-afternoon the stock had slumped over four percent to A$6.98.

Simsmetal cited lower demand and lower prices, both locally and overseas, for both secondary ferrous and non-ferrous metals, saying the ferrous division in particular experienced intense margin pressure in the second quarter.
"It's a soft result even though it was flagged," said a Sydney-based dealer.
However, the company said the contribution from the non-ferrous division improved in the second quarter as prices strengthened, while the aluminium division also picked up in the second quarter.
An improvement in second half profitability due to a general improvement in demand for secondary ferrous and non-ferrous metals was also expected, Simsmetal said.
Simsmetal shares closed 29 cents lower at A$6.99 on turnover of 281,421 shares.
